svg.aria-label: Sixty scattered directions off a surface, drawn uniformly over the hemisphere and drawn with a cosine weighting that favours the normal.
svg.text: Sixty scattered directions from one hit point. Both cover the hemisphere; the right one puts more of them
where the rendering equation weights them most — 27% within 30° of the normal against 13%.
A direction near the horizon arrives at a glancing angle and contributes almost nothing, so spending samples there is
spending them on an answer close to zero. Matching the sampling to the cosθ already in the integrand is the whole idea.
